versions.changelog:
- Added suite_url ("https://github.com/raguets/overpowered") to metadata.
- Updated description to mention Overpowered suite.
- Retitled to "Overpowered / Checkpoint".
- Removed skill-card.md file.

Initial release.

- Introduces the "checkpoint" skill for creating durable, self-contained state packages.
- Defines a structured procedure for persisting actionable project state in CHECKPOINT.md, enabling context resets and handoffs.
- Lists criteria for what to capture, including goals, current state, context, decisions, known issues, and next actions.
- Specifies a receiver test to ensure sufficient information for resumption by a new agent.
- Clarifies common pitfalls and provides a clear stop condition.
